root_cause.text: The USB anchor memory was allocated using devm_kmalloc tied to the parent USB device instead of the USB interface, causing its lifetime to be incorrectly bound to the parent device rather than the driver's interface binding, leading to resource leaks on driver unbind.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `devm_kmalloc(&usb_dev->dev, ...)` to `devm_kmalloc(&usb_intf->dev, ...)`, and the commit message explicitly states that device-managed resources should be tied to the interface (usb_intf->dev) because USB drivers bind to interfaces, avoiding memory leaks when drivers are unbound without device disconnection.
